name: FederalRegister.gov document catalog

operator.name: Office of the Federal Register/NARA and US Government Publishing Office

capabilities: Documented anonymous API v1 full-text metadata search and native-document retrieval; tested 2024 final-rule subset.
Exact agency/date/type/citation/correction identities retained. Informational HTML and official PDF destinations distinguished.
licensing: Current OFR/GPO About page cites 1 CFR2.6 permitting reproduction/republishing of Federal Register editions. Public API metadata and document text are distinct from third-party links, incorporated external standards and government trademarks.
limitations: One FR origin represented in FederalRegister.gov and GovInfo official editions; not two independent copies of the same legal publication.
Informational HTML/XML is not the official edition or independent proof a rule is currently in force.
Research parser deliberately supports the tested modern four-digit document-number family plus C-number correction prefixes; legacy two-digit IDs remain outside this adapter.
USA federal/English subset; India and other legal jurisdictions not covered.

Native correction-table expansion is outside keyboard Tab order; modal Escape returns BODY, header semantics and hidden skip-link limitations remain. Pointer/touch opening plus horizontal wheel scrolling and official PDF are observed alternatives, not full accessibility certification.
Official PDF page extracts can include adjacent regulations and text extraction can corrupt chemical notation; preserve native IDs/page boundaries and official visual rendering.
next_action: Maintain scoped2024 publication-metadata qualification; monitor published API/policy/correction changes. Preserve documented native-reader accessibility limitations and distinguish official PDF from informational HTML. No activation approval or current-law claim.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: OFR/NARA and GPO jointly administer one Federal Register publication catalog; HTML/XML, official PDFs and correction notices retain separate roles.

operator.name: Office of the Federal Register/NARA and US Government Publishing Office

facts.native_identity: document_number plus citation, publication date, issuing agency and snapshot hash; do not derive publication year from number prefix.
facts.overlap: GovInfo hosts official editions of the same FR documents. Existing govinfo source is a broader GPO catalog; these copies do not add an independent FR origin.
facts.correction_identity: C1-2024-01530 links back to2024-01530; distinct correction publication, not a replacement title-only match.
facts.pdf_boundary: Official PDF for2024-31419 spans three printed pages and includes preceding document2024-31384 ending. Native FR Doc footer uses an en dash; file/title alone is not an exclusive content boundary.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Current examples cover USA federal English final-rule metadata published in2024 across five subjects. Official API describes search coverage since1994; this does not establish all historical ID families or current legal effect.

facts.publication_vs_effective: 2024 publication dates may have2025 effective dates; one result has effective_on=null. A 2023-prefixed number is published2024.
facts.country_boundary: No India-source or country-network-vantage claim; no owner/parcel/property lookups.

query_contract.summary: Published OpenAPI specification supplies exact GET shapes and no-key authentication. Five topic cases and five distinct known-document round trips pass.

facts.empty: HTTP200 count0 can omit results; original parse failure and offline reinterpretation retained.
facts.error: Missing native document returns404 HTML; malformed year returned200, description year0 and year2000 documents. Reject invalid year syntax before sending and enforce actual returned year/type.
facts.legacy_limit: Year2000 results use00- prefixed numbers, outside the explicitly scoped modern parser; not nonexistent documents.

rights_and_cost.summary: Public API needs no key. The official About page expressly permits reproducing Federal Register editions under1 CFR2.6; legal status and external-content exceptions remain distinct.

facts.metadata: Public supported field-selected API; retain native source/citation and provenance.
facts.content: Any person may reproduce or republish material in regular/special FR editions under cited rule. This does not license external incorporated standards or unrelated sites.
facts.legal_reliance: OFR/GPO explicitly calls this XML/HTML resource unofficial informational; verify official edition for legal research.
facts.accounts: MyFR saved searches/comments accounts are separate and unused. No payment/key/signup needed for tested retrieval.
facts.limits: No numeric quota or SLA found; no inference of unlimited capacity.

reader_access.summary: Anonymous HTML and official PDF access verified for the scoped 2024 publication catalog. Native table touch/pointer expansion and horizontal wheel scrolling work; keyboard-only expansion, header semantics and focus restoration have recorded limitations. Completion means characterized scoped access, not universal accessibility conformance.

facts.pdf_text_native_footer: FR Doc.2024–31419; also adjacent2024–31384, both preserved.
facts.later_session_readers: Four fresh WebKit contexts: FDA desktop, FSIS mobile, correction mobile, HHS withdrawal desktop; native ID visible, no visible password fields. Four screenshots visually reviewed.
facts.mobile_overflow: Document391px at390px viewport; expanded native table has horizontal auto overflow. Touch opens it; wheel gesture reveals rightmost Other column. Keyboard-only expansion remains unsupported in observed native control.
facts.keyboard: First ten stops sampled: desktop starts Home/Sections navigation; mobile Toggle Navigation Menu/Home. This is not proof of screen-reader usability.
facts.remaining_destinations: Eight remaining native HTML URLs return200, native title/document metadata visible. Three long responses hit512KiB capture bound; never claim those are complete retained full texts.
facts.accessibility_policy: Provider says designed using Section508/W3C guidelines; this is a provider statement, not independent conformance certification.

focused_mobile_table.result: First visible correction table453.84px in280px wrapper with overflow-x:hidden and tabIndex-1. No auto/scroll ancestor found. Cells appear in the accessibility tree but header row is ordinary cells, not header semantics.
focused_mobile_table.skip_link: Skip to Content exists but display:none, zero rectangle; not in sampled keyboard sequence.
focused_mobile_table.visual_review: Initial clipping preserved; follow-up touch expansion and horizontal wheel scrolling expose the full header. Keyboard Tab skips span control; official two-page correction PDF also verified.
focused_mobile_table.limitation: DOM scroll test was diagnostic, not a user gesture or screen-reader test.

table_expander.control: span.expand-table-link, no button role or tabindex; preceding CFR link Tab moves directly to the following CFR link in desktop/mobile WebKit.
table_expander.touch_and_pointer: Both open native modal; no account/password needed.
table_expander.horizontal_gesture: At390px viewport, actual Playwright mouse.wheel(600,0) moved native scroll pane125px; last Other column right359.34px lies within pane right369.5px. Touch activation tested; finger-swipe scrolling not independently tested.
table_expander.closing: Escape closes modal in both viewports; focus returns BODY rather than invoking control.
known_accessibility_barriers: Expansion icon outside keyboard tab sequence
Native table header cells are td, not th
Skip-to-content link hidden in sampled layout
Modal close icon is a span; Escape works
No claim of accessible chemical notation or screen-reader conformance

official_correction_pdf.access: Anonymous HTTP200, complete bounded PDF; two pages rendered and visually reviewed.
official_correction_pdf.identity: Printed7624–7625; footer FR Doc.C1–2024–01530. Prose parent2024–1530 omits leading zero; canonical API parent2024-01530 retained.
official_correction_pdf.boundaries: First page begins with preceding2024–02085; second page continues after correction footer with Chlorpyrifos; Reinstatement of Tolerances. PDF pages are not pure single-record text.
official_correction_pdf.text_extraction: Layout extraction retains content but chemical superscripts/minus glyphs can degrade (e.g. Cl¥); use visual official PDF for those tables, not unreviewed extracted plain text.

facts.scope_limits: Desktop/mobile browser, DOM/keyboard/touch/pointer observations and two complete short official PDFs. No full accessibility certification, assistive-device test, all-country availability, current legal effect or third-party-standard access claim.

quality_and_relevance.summary: The scoped 2024 English final-rule search has explicit relevance, correction, supersession and language boundaries; no current-law inference is supported.

facts.food_labeling: Two equal titles belong to FDA and FSIS; frozen-cherry-pie standards are related food-standard content, not a literal title match.
facts.airworthiness: Equal Airbus titles concern different aircraft and native directives; publication year differs from one number prefix.
facts.hazardous_waste: Some hits are specific facility/exclusion changes, not broad waste guidance; do not tag them as property-owner discovery.
facts.correction: Source provides correction links; supplemental current-law/withdrawal checking remains necessary.

withdrawal_ambiguity.2024-28128: HHS withdraws the Federal Register publication, explicitly says Scientific Integrity Policy remains in effect.

withdrawal_ambiguity.2024-27263: Partial withdrawal of failure-to-submit findings, not a generic clean-air guide.

facts.supersession: Five superseding-term results have ordinary action labels such as Final rule. Abstracts carry the supersession semantics; action/type/correction_of alone cannot resolve present legal effect.

correction_relationship.meaning: Keep separate publications; do not merge by equal title.

unicode.interpretation: No automatic translation or broad multilingual recall supported; empty English-catalog queries do not establish no free knowledge in those languages.

facts.lifecycle_contract: Preserve action,dates,disposition_notes as optional metadata; native links and request identity validated. Text matching is a review aid, not automated legal-effect classification.

operating_limits.summary: Ten saved requests pass unchanged in two separate sessions; explicit research refresh review preserves history on failure and requires review for changed metadata, corrections or missing page entries.

facts.refresh_identity: Mutable API response hash/observation date; publication/effective date is not last API revision.

later_session.reliability_limit: Two same-day sessions, no long-term SLA or later-day availability claim.

facts.maintenance_owner: MyBookshelf research completion program: issue164/program and168/civic. Runtime maintenance ownership is separate and no runtime integration is authorized.
facts.review_cadence: On future research sessions or published policy/schema/correction changes, revalidate a bounded selected request under current robots. Compare source identity, native document number, correction links, publication/effective dates and observed hash. Preserve all older snapshots.
facts.failure_policy: HTTP403/429/503/timeouts stop the provider run; missing404 is unavailable, never repealed/deleted. A missing result from a page is not removal from the catalog. No automatic retry or automatic snapshot replacement.
facts.refresh_implementation: tools/research/civic_catalogs.py:review_federal_refresh; offline only, never imports or alters production sources.
facts.fixture_evidence: Six regression tests cover unavailable status, hash/scope mismatch, changed correction/action/effective date, page disappearance, wrong-native lookup and identical repeat. Fixtures are synthetic; two-session unchanged comparison uses real observations.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain one complete, narrowly scoped2024 Federal Register publication catalog dossier with ten current distinct examples and explicit reader/current-law limitations. Research qualification does not approve production activation.
